questions.question: Count by 10s from 40. What are the next 3 numbers?
questions.explain: Add 10 each time: 40 goes to 50, then 60, then 70. A common trap is counting by 1s or 3s instead of 10s.

questions.question: Count by 25s from 100. What are the next 2 numbers?
questions.explain: Add 25 each step: 100 to 125, then 125 to 150. Watch out for slipping to 140 by accidentally adding only 15 the second time.

questions.question: Count back by 100s from 500. What are the next 3 numbers?
questions.explain: Take away 100 each time: 500, 400, 300, 200. A common slip is writing 210 instead of 200 when you cross the hundreds line.

questions.question: Count by 4s from 20. What are the next 3 numbers?
questions.explain: Add 4 each step: 20, 24, 28, 32. The easy mistake is writing 30 instead of 32 when the ones pass 9.

questions.question: A park trail has a sign every 25 metres. The first sign is at 50 m. What is the 3rd sign after that one?
questions.explain: Count forward by 25: 50, 75, 100, 125. The 3rd sign after 50 is 125 m. A common slip is adding 20 instead of 25 and landing on 110.

questions.question: Sam is counting back by 3s from 30 to track his board-game score. What are the next 4 numbers he says?
questions.explain: Subtract 3 each step: 30, 27, 24, 21, 18. The tricky part is 24 to 21 — a common slip is writing 20 instead.

questions.question: An apartment stairwell has a number plate every 4 steps. The first plate after the ground floor is 4. What number is on the 5th plate?
questions.explain: Count forward by 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. The 5th plate is 20. A common error is using a step of 3 and landing on 15.

questions.question: A farm stand has 120 eggs in the first basket. Each next basket has 100 more. How many eggs are in the 3rd basket?
questions.explain: Count forward by 100: 120, 220, 320. The 3rd basket has 320 eggs. A common slip is writing 310 by mixing up the tens and hundreds.

questions.question: Maya starts at 40 and hops forward by 10s until she reaches 90. Then she hops back 2 times. Where does she land?
questions.explain: From 90, hop back 10 twice: 80, then 70. The common trap is hopping 3 times (to 60) or going forward to 100.

questions.question: A pattern goes: 215, 240, 265, ___, 315. What is the missing number?
questions.explain: Each step adds 25, so 265 + 25 = 290. A common slip is adding 20 and getting 285, or adding 30 and getting 295.

questions.question: Tom counts by 3s from 12. He says: 15, 18, 21, 25. What is his mistake?
questions.explain: After 21, adding 3 gives 24, not 25. Tom jumped 4 instead of 3 on that last step, which is a wrong-step slip.

questions.question: Ana starts at 41 on a number line. Each jump takes her back 4. Where does she land after 3 jumps?
questions.explain: Count back by 4s from 41: 37, 33, 29. The tricky part is passing 30 — after 33 comes 29, not 30.

questions.question: Grade 3 has raised $250 for a class trip. They raise $25 more each week. How much will they have after 3 weeks?
questions.explain: Add 25 each week: 275, then 300, then 325. Watch the step past 300 — 300 and 25 more is 325, not 315.

questions.question: Sara counts back by 10s from 330. She says: 320, 310, 300, 200. What is her mistake?
options: She used 5s all the way, not 10s.
She counted up, not back, by 10s.
questions.explain: Counting back by 10s goes 320, 310, 300, 290. At a hundred the count still drops by ten, so 300 becomes 290.

questions.question: The bus stop signs on Jo's street go up by 3s. The signs read 54, 57, ___, 63. What number is on the missing sign?
questions.explain: 57 and 3 more is 60, and 60 and 3 more is 63. Crossing 60 is the trap — 57 plus 3 is 60, not 59.
